يرتهنون (form VIII)
# يَرْتَهِنُونَ (yartahinūna) /jar.ta.hi.nuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
# يُرْتَهَنُونَ (yurtahanūna) /jur.ta.ha.nuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِرْتَهَنَ (irtahana)
